name: unifor-quest
description: UNIFOR Quest - a 2D top-down game in TypeScript

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @unifor-quest/game
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @unifor-quest/core && npm run build -w @unifor-quest/runner && npm run build -w @unifor-quest/lsp && npm run build -w @unifor-quest/campus && npm run build -w @unifor-quest/lang-typescript && npm run build -w @unifor-quest/lang-go && npm run build -w @unifor-quest/lang-java && npm run build -w @unifor-quest/lang-python && npm run build -w @unifor-quest/lang-elixir && npm run build -w @unifor-quest/conformance && npm run generate:maps && npm run sync:map-assets
